title: betula mandshurica var. japonica
intro: Betula mandshurica var. japonica, commonly known as Japanese Birch, is a deciduous tree species native to East Asia. It is valued for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antiseptic effects, which can aid in the treatment of various conditions such as fever, cough, and bronchitis. The plant's therapeutic actions include soothing and calming effects, as well as its ability to stimulate digestion and relieve respiratory issues. Bioactive constituents of Japanese Birch include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
